paite: Huai ban ah unaute aw, tanchinhoih ka hon hilh zaw ka hon theisak nawn ding a; huai tanchinhoih na kipahpih ua, huai mah ah na dingh ua;
heading: Khrist Thohnawnna Makai
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

paite: k'on thuhilh pen na mawk gintak uh hilou a, pomkip na hih uleh, huai mah ah hotdam in na om uhi.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

paite: Amasapen in ke'n ka muh sam nou ka hon hilhsawn a; huchi a, Laisiangthou bangbang a i khelhnate ziak a Khrist asih a,
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

paite: vui a a-om a, laisiangthou bangbang a ani thum ni a kaihthoh a a-omdan,
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

paite: huchi a Kifas kiang a akilak a, huai khit a sawm-le-nihte kiang a akilak thute,
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

paite: huai khit in unau zanga sang a tamzawte kiang ah khatvei thu in akilak nawn a, huaite lak a mi, atamzaw tutan in adam lai ua, khenkhat bel a-ihmuta uhi.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

paite: Huai khit in Jakob leh sawltak tengteng kiang ah akilak nawn hi.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

paite: Huan atawp pen ah, ahun lou bang a piang, keimah kiang ah leng akilak hi.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

paite: Kei zaw sawltak lak a neupen, Pathian saptuamte ka sawi ziak a sawltak chih tuak louh ka hi.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

paite: Himahleh Pathian hehpihna ziak in ka hihhih ka hita; huan ahehpihna hon piak athawn in a-om kei a, huchih nak sang in amau tengteng sang in ka semgimzaw hi; himahleh keimah kia in ka sem kei a, Pathian hehpihna ka kiang a om in asem zaw hi.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

paite: Himahleh, ke'n leng, amau leng huchi in ka gen zel ua, huchi in nou leng na gingta uhi.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

paite: Huan Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om chih ahon hilh ngal uleh, bangchidan ahia na lak ua khenkhat in, misi thohnawnna himhim a-om kei na chih uh?
heading: Gingtute Thohnawnna
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

paite: Misi thohnawnna himhim om lou ahihleh, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

paite: Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, i thugen uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na gin uh leng bangmah lou ahi ding hi.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

paite: Ahi, Khrist akaithou chih Pathian i theihpih ziak in, Pathian lam thu ah theihpih zuauthei i hong hi ding hi, misite kaihthoh a a-om kei uleh, amah leng akaithou kei ding hi.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

paite: Misite kaihthoh a a-om kei un zaw, Khrist leng kaihthoh in a-omta kei ding.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

paite: Huan Khrist kaihthoh a a-om keileh, na gin uh bangmah lou ahi ding a, na khelhna uah na om nilouh uh ahi ding.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

paite: Huchi hileh, Khrist a ihmusate mangthangta uh ahi ding hi.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

paite: Tu damsung kia a Khrist tung a lametna i neih in zaw mi tengteng lak a mi hehpihhuaipen i hi ding hi.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

paite: Himahleh Khrist misi lak a kipan kaihthoh in a-om taktak ahi, ihmute lak a kipan gah masa ana hita hi.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

paite: Mi khat ziak a sihna ahong om ziak in mi khat ziak mah in misi thohnawnna leng ahong omta ahi.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

paite: Adam ah mi tengteng asi mah bang un, Khrist ah mi tengteng hihhin in leng a-om ding uhi.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

paite: Himahleh amau hun chiat ah; Khrist gah masapente ahi a; huai khit chiang in ahong pai nawn na ah Khrist ate athou ding uhi.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

paite: Huai khit chiang in atawp ahong tung ding; huai hun chiang in, vaihawmna tengteng, thuneihna leh thilhihtheihna tengteng ahihman nung in, Pathian kiang ah, Pa kiang ngei ah gam ape ding hi.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

paite: Amelmate tengteng akhenuai a akoih masiah ama'n vai hawm ding ahi ngal a.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

paite: Melma nanungpen hihmang a om ding sihna ahi.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

paite: Ama'n, "Akhenuai ah bangkim akoih hi." Himahleh, "Akhenuai ah bangkim koih in a-om," achih in anuai a bangkim koihpa apang kha kei chih akimu gige ahi.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

paite: Huan anuai a bangkim koih a a-om hun chiang in, Tapa mahmah leng anuai ah koih in a-om ding; Pathian bangkim a bangkim ahihtheihna ding in.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

paite: Huchi ahih kei in, misite a ding a baptisma atansak uh bang achihna uh hi ding ahia? Misite kaihthoh a om lou ding ahih uleh bang achia amaute a dia baptisma tansak uh ahia?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

paite: Bangziak a eite dakkal chih a sih lauhuai a om i hi ua?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

paite: Unaute aw, Khrist Jesu i Toupa a ka hon suanna sial in niteng in ka si, ka chi ahi.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

paite: Mihing dan in gen leng Ephesa a gamsate kilaipih ka hihleh, kei a ding in bang aphatuam dia? "Misi, kaihthoh a a-om kei ding uleh ne in dawn leng ake, zingchiang a si ding hi ve hang in."
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

paite: Khem in om kei un, "Lawm giloute'n omdan hoih ahihgawp nak uhi."
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

paite: Kizentak in halh unla, thil hihkhial kei un; khenkhat in Pathian theihna himhim na nei kei ua. Hiai tuh na zumna ding ua ka gen ahi.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

paite: Himahleh kuahiam khat in, "Misi bangchi in kaihthoh ahi ding uh? Pumpi bangchibang pu in ahia ahong thoh ding?" chi ahi ding e.
heading: Thounawn Pumpi
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

paite: Nang, mihai, nang mahmah in na tuh leng, asih phot keileh hihhin in a-om sam a;
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

paite: huan chi na tuh in apumpi hong om ding pen ahi kei a, atang lel na tuh zaw nak, buhtang hiam, chi dang tang hiam ahi thei hi.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in ama deih bangbang in pumpi apia a, haichitang chih kiang ah amau pumpi chiat apia hi.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

paite: Sa tengteng sa chi khat ahi kei ua; mihing sa atuam a, gamsa sa atuam; vasa sa atuam a, ngasa sa atuam hi.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

paite: Van pumpi a-om a, leitung pumpi leng a-om, himahleh van lam pumpite thupina atuam a, lei lam pumpite thupina atuam hi.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

paite: Nisa thupina atuam a, khapi thupina atuam a, aksite thupina atuam; aksi leh aksi leng athupina uh atuam ziak in.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

paite: Misite thohnawnna leng tua bang ahi. Muat thei a tuh in a-om a, muat thei lou a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

paite: Pahtawi louh a tuh in a-om a, thupitak a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Hat lou a tuh in a-om a, thilhihtheihna nei a kaihthoh in a-om hi.
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

paite: Pianken pumpi a tuh in a-om a, khalam pumpi a kaihthoh in a-om hi. Pianken pumpi a-omleh khalam pumpi leng a-om hi.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

paite: Huchi in mi masapen, "Adam mihing ahong hi a," chi a gelh ahi; Adam nanung pen bel hinna pepa kha ahong hita hi.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

paite: Himahleh khalam a-om masa kei a, salam a-om zaw; huai zoh in khalam pen a-om hi.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

paite: Mihing masa pen lei a siam, leimi ahi a; mihing nihna pen van a pan ahi.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

paite: Lei a siam mihing leimi ahih bang in, van a kipan mi tuh vanmi ahi.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

paite: Huan lei a siam mihing batna i put bang in, van a kipan hong paipa batna leng i pu sam ding uhi.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

paite: Unaute aw, sa leh sisan in Pathian lalgam aluah thei kei ding a; muat thei in muat theihlouhna aluah sam kei ding chih, ka gen ahi.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

paite: Ngai un, thuguk ka hon hilh ding hi! I vek un i ihmu khol kei ding ua, himahleh i vek un pengkul nanungpen agin chiang in, sawt lou kal in,
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

paite: Mitphiat kal lou in hihlamdan in i om vekta ding; pengkul ging ding ahi ngal a, huchi in misite muat thei lou in kaihthoh in a-om ding ua, eite leng hihlamdan in i omta ding uhi.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

paite: Hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh ding ahi a, hiai sithei in leng sih theihlouhna asilh sam ding ahi.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

paite: Huchi a hiai muat thei in muat theihlouhna asilh a, hiai sithei in sih theihlouhna asilh hun chiang in, huai hun ngeingei in, "Zohna in sihna avalh zouta," chih thugelh ahong tung ding hi.
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

paite: "Aw sihna, na gu koi a-omta ahia? Aw han, na zohna koi a-omta ahia?"
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

paite: Sihna gu khelhna ahi a; khelhna thilhihtheihna dan ahi.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

paite: Himahleh i Toupa Jesu Khrist ziak a zohna hon pepa Pathian kiang ah kipahthu om hen.
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in ka unau deihtakte aw, kiptak in, hihlin vual louh in, Toupa nasep phatuamngaitak a sem gige in om un, na sepgimna uh Toupa ah athawn ngei kei chih na thei uhi.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
